← About WorkIntel Hub Author

Pavan

P Editor, WorkIntel Hub
133 articles · Writing since May 6, 2026

Pavan is the editor of WorkIntel Hub and covers how organizations measure and manage work: employee productivity, time tracking, workforce monitoring, and the HR processes that sit around them, from the offer letter to the final paycheck. Pavan writes the site's long-form guides, builds the calculators, checklists and document generators inside them, and maintains the state-by-state tables on final pay, pay transparency and monitoring law that managers turn to when a deadline is real.

The work sits where operations, HR compliance and workforce analytics meet. Every guide starts from the primary source, whether that is the statute, the agency's own guidance or the dataset, and cites it with its date and sample so a reader can check the claim. Where a widely repeated statistic does not hold up, the guide says so rather than repeating it. Guides are written for managers who have to decide on a Monday morning, so each one ends with something specific enough to act on.

Areas of focus: US wage and hour rules under the FLSA and state law, employee monitoring law and practice, HR documentation for hiring, discipline and separation, and the metrics teams use to run themselves. For corrections, source questions or press inquiries, use the email below.
